audience: This page is for people pricing LangSmith, because that is what the pricing page sells. The verdict says it plainly: Plus is $39 a seat, then you pay for traces. The open-source LangChain and LangGraph libraries do not have a separate price in the data. If you only wanted the libraries, you are not looking at a seat.

It is a poor fit if you wanted one number that covers production traffic. A seat is only the start. Traces and LSUs add up. One LSU is $1, and Engine runs can use many of them. A prototype on the Developer seat can look free and a busy graph will not.
features: Developer is $0 a seat, limited to 1 seat, with 5,000 base traces a month, then pay as you go. Plus is $39 a seat a month, with 10,000 base traces a month, then pay as you go. Enterprise is custom. The Developer plan being free for one seat is a real pro. It is also a one-seat pro.

Plus includes a small serverless deployment. That is the other pro, and the word small is doing work. It is not an unlimited hosting tier. Traces are billed for what you use, which is the third pro and the reason the bill can move after you like the product.
The page does not list a separate price for the libraries. Installing LangChain is not the same purchase as a LangSmith seat. Keep those on different lines of the budget.
limitations: Five thousand base traces, then pay as you go, means the $0 seat is a base. Ten thousand on Plus is a larger base at $39, not a cap. We do not have a per-trace dollar rate in the table, so we do not invent one. The unit we do have is the LSU: 1 LSU is $1.
Engine runs can use many LSUs. A dollar each stops being small when a run spends several. The cons say this on purpose. Price a real run before you treat Plus as $39 all-in.
The rating is Depends. The seat prices are clear. The usage on top is the condition. Depends means read the trace and LSU lines, not just the $39.
pricingNotes: This is LangSmith pricing from langchain.com/pricing, checked 14 October 2026. Developer is $0 a seat for 1 seat, with 5,000 base traces a month, then pay as you go. Plus is $39 a seat a month, with 10,000 base traces, then pay as you go. Enterprise is custom.

The page does not list a separate price for the open-source LangChain or LangGraph libraries. One LSU is $1. Plus includes a small serverless deployment. No annual seat price is in the table, so none is printed.

faqs.q: Am I paying for LangChain or LangSmith?
faqs.a: The pricing page sells LangSmith. Plus is $39 a seat, then traces. The libraries do not have a separate price in the data.
The cons say 1 LSU is $1, and Engine runs can use many of them. The seat is not a substitute for that meter.
It is $0 for one seat and 5,000 base traces a month, then pay as you go. It is enough to see the product. It is not a team plan, and the base is not a ceiling that stays free.
A small serverless deployment. The word in the pros is small. Traces above the 10,000 base are still pay as you go.
